chapters.title: Chapter 759 - Wrath, Envy, and Greed
paragraphs: The first day of The Eternal Challenge kicked off with a series of spectacular performances across multiple contests, leaving the audience in awe. Team Destroyer set the tone early, delivering an extraordinary display of dominance. Despite having only five members, they nearly wiped out every opponent they faced—even players who weren't ordinary by any measure, with two Divine Champions on the opposing side.

In another highlight of the day, the Beast Battle contest unfolded with just as much intensity. Like Team Destroyer, Jovina, a member of the Vensalor Guild, completely dominated all three of her matches. Even when she faced an evenly matched opponent in Marlene, the Gluttony Champion, Jovina emerged victorious. She summoned a massive Fae Beast in the form of a wolf covered in molten lava, a fearsome creature that left the crowd and her opponent stunned.
"Jovina takes another victory!" the caster shouted excitedly.

Jovina, wearing a subtle smile of triumph, approached Marlene, who stood silently after her defeat. Extending her hand toward the red-haired girl, Jovina smirked and said, "Work harder next time... you're not on my level yet, hah!"
Marlene responded with nothing but a faint smile, her lips curling slightly as she shook Jovina's hand. Without a word, the two left the arena.

Next up, the second round of the Raid Race resumed, with Team Destroyer now facing the winners from the first round. Interestingly, as the match progressed, more extraordinary figures from across Yunatea began to make their appearance. Among them were players with Epic-grade classes and even several Divine Champions.
"This is absolutely incredible! There are three more Divine Champions competing in this Raid Race!"
"And yes, this time, I don't think Melliandra will have as much freedom to dominate like she did in the previous round."
"Yeah, I'm not so sure they'll breeze through this one as easily as before."

As soon as the Raid Race began, all six teams in the arena quickly shifted their focus to dealing with the waves of monsters. Speed was critical—they had to clear the waves as quickly as possible, because any delay would give rival teams the chance to finish their own waves and move in to disrupt their progress.

"Paul, we're still here watching this Raid Race unfold, and the memory of the battles from the previous round is still fresh in everyone's minds," Brando began, his tone eager for insight. "I'd love to hear your analysis of this round, especially now that we have more Divine Champions competing as potential threats to Team Destroyer. And, as we know, they're still sticking with just five members. Do you think this is a show of confidence on their part? Or is Broken really not even necessary, even at this stage?"

Paul replied in a composed tone. "Well, I'm not entirely sure what's going on. However, there have been reports that Broken was spotted still active in the game. Maybe he stepped back from this contest for some reason, or perhaps there's more to it. But..." he paused for a moment, letting the tension build.

"We do know that the three Divine Champions competing in this match have the capability to easily counter Melliandra, who serves as Team Destroyer's main damage dealer. If they succeed, it could also make it difficult for Kingsley to perform at his full potential," Paul concluded.

At the same time, the tension in the game skyrocketed as Team Destroyer finished their monster wave with remarkable speed. But it was clear from the movements of other players across the arena that trouble was brewing—they were once again converging on Team Destroyer.
"The contestants in this match still see Team Destroyer as the biggest threat, given how much effort they're focusing entirely on them," Brando remarked.

"Yeah, that's to be expected. Look, Melliandra is already sprinting onto the transparent platforms, aiming to launch herself higher and prepare for the same aerial strategy she used before," Paul added.

The camera suddenly cut to a player in the arena wearing light armor, his body lean but visibly scarred. He was a Beastkin with the head of a rat and was clearly identified as a player—and a Greed Champion. He was Mooz.
Another screen in the arena began playing a short interview clip of this player. The man, his long black hair falling to his shoulders, stared directly into the camera with his large, intense eyes.
"I will render Kingsley useless in this match!" he declared in the interview.

The live feed returned just in time to show Kingsley beginning his transformation into his Armored Bear form. Before he could fully shift, the player named Mooz sprinted forward with incredible speed. In one swift movement, Mooz leapt into the air, his body twisting as he ascended. Suddenly, his frame grew larger, and his form shifted—mimicking Kingsley's transformation, but into an Armored Hawk instead.

"Mooz has just revealed the power of his Greed Blessing!" Brando shouted in excitement. "Mooz can temporarily steal another player's ability, which means Kingsley won't be able to take flight to protect Melliandra anymore!"

Mooz, now in Kingsley's stolen transformation as the massive Armored Hawk, soared through the air with impressive speed, chasing down Melliandra, who struggled to navigate the transparent platforms high above the arena. The girl's agility was impressive, but the relentless pursuit from the hawk form was making it increasingly difficult for her to evade.

Meanwhile, on the ground, the camera shifted to another player. A figure in light armor with long blonde hair stood calmly, hidden among the cover of the environment. Suddenly, in his hand, he summoned something—a sniper rifle, identical to Melliandra's!

"That's Nexthar for you," Paul remarked. "Nexthar is an Envy Champion, and his blessing allows him to copy the equipment of his opponents. While it's only temporary, he can wield any copied equipment with incredible precision and efficiency. And now, he's copied Melliandra's sniper rifle."

From a distance, Nexthar crouched, raising the rifle and taking aim at Melliandra. The girl, already overwhelmed by the ferocious attacks of the Armored Hawk, was now in the crosshairs of her own weapon. With calm precision, Nexthar fired, his shot whistling through the air toward the distracted sniper.
Another screen switched to an interview with the man behind the gamertag Nexthar. His demeanor was relaxed but laced with a quiet confidence.

"Well, I'm just here to have fun," he said casually, leaning slightly into the camera. "So, I'll do my best to win this match. And yes... we'll be following the trend—taking down Team Destroyer is the top priority. I think this is going to be an exciting challenge."

The camera shifted once more, now focusing on another player in the arena—a beastkin with the appearance of a werewolf. His large frame was clad in heavy armor, giving him an imposing presence, but it did nothing to hinder his agility as he charged swiftly toward Goldrich and the others.

Paul stepped in to explain. "That's Venom, the Wrath Champion. If I'm not mistaken, this guy gains a boost to his power—either in level or stats—the more enemies he takes down in a short period of time."
Brando quickly added, "So that explains why he cleared the entire monster wave by himself?"
"Yes, that's exactly why," Paul confirmed.

The audience collectively gasped in shock as the first victim of this round fell. On the massive display, the player's name and avatar profile turned crimson, marking their elimination from the match.
"Melliandra has been defeated!" Brando shouted, his voice filled with astonishment.

sentences.text: The first day of The Eternal Challenge kicked off with a series of spectacular performances across multiple contests, leaving the audience in awe.
Team Destroyer set the tone early, delivering an extraordinary display of dominance.
Despite having only five members, they nearly wiped out every opponent they faced—even players who weren't ordinary by any measure, with two Divine Champions on the opposing side.
In another highlight of the day, the Beast Battle contest unfolded with just as much intensity.
Like Team Destroyer, Jovina, a member of the Vensalor Guild, completely dominated all three of her matches.
Even when she faced an evenly matched opponent in Marlene, the Gluttony Champion, Jovina emerged victorious.
She summoned a massive Fae Beast in the form of a wolf covered in molten lava, a fearsome creature that left the crowd and her opponent stunned.
"Jovina takes another victory!" the caster shouted excitedly.
Jovina, wearing a subtle smile of triumph, approached Marlene, who stood silently after her defeat.
Extending her hand toward the red-haired girl, Jovina smirked and said, "Work harder next time... you're not on my level yet, hah!"
Marlene responded with nothing but a faint smile, her lips curling slightly as she shook Jovina's hand.
Without a word, the two left the arena.
Next up, the second round of the Raid Race resumed, with Team Destroyer now facing the winners from the first round.
Interestingly, as the match progressed, more extraordinary figures from across Yunatea began to make their appearance.
Among them were players with Epic-grade classes and even several Divine Champions.
"This is absolutely incredible!
There are three more Divine Champions competing in this Raid Race!"
"And yes, this time, I don't think Melliandra will have as much freedom to dominate like she did in the previous round."
"Yeah, I'm not so sure they'll breeze through this one as easily as before."
As soon as the Raid Race began, all six teams in the arena quickly shifted their focus to dealing with the waves of monsters.
Speed was critical—they had to clear the waves as quickly as possible, because any delay would give rival teams the chance to finish their own waves and move in to disrupt their progress.
"Paul, we're still here watching this Raid Race unfold, and the memory of the battles from the previous round is still fresh in everyone's minds," Brando began, his tone eager for insight.
"I'd love to hear your analysis of this round, especially now that we have more Divine Champions competing as potential threats to Team Destroyer.
And, as we know, they're still sticking with just five members.
Do you think this is a show of confidence on their part?
Or is Broken really not even necessary, even at this stage?"
Paul replied in a composed tone.
"Well, I'm not entirely sure what's going on.
However, there have been reports that Broken was spotted still active in the game.
Maybe he stepped back from this contest for some reason, or perhaps there's more to it.
But..." he paused for a moment, letting the tension build.
"We do know that the three Divine Champions competing in this match have the capability to easily counter Melliandra, who serves as Team Destroyer's main damage dealer.
If they succeed, it could also make it difficult for Kingsley to perform at his full potential," Paul concluded.
At the same time, the tension in the game skyrocketed as Team Destroyer finished their monster wave with remarkable speed.
But it was clear from the movements of other players across the arena that trouble was brewing—they were once again converging on Team Destroyer.

He was Mooz.
Another screen in the arena began playing a short interview clip of this player.
The man, his long black hair falling to his shoulders, stared directly into the camera with his large, intense eyes.
"I will render Kingsley useless in this match!" he declared in the interview.
The live feed returned just in time to show Kingsley beginning his transformation into his Armored Bear form.
Before he could fully shift, the player named Mooz sprinted forward with incredible speed.
In one swift movement, Mooz leapt into the air, his body twisting as he ascended.
Suddenly, his frame grew larger, and his form shifted—mimicking Kingsley's transformation, but into an Armored Hawk instead.

While it's only temporary, he can wield any copied equipment with incredible precision and efficiency.
And now, he's copied Melliandra's sniper rifle."

chapters.title: Chapter 760: The Fall of Giants (Full-Length)
paragraphs: The remaining five teams in the arena pressed on with their challenges, each still working through their respective puzzles and battling new waves of monsters.
Two of the teams had already solved their puzzles and were advancing to face another set of monster waves. With victory now within reach, they were just a step away from confronting the Raid Boss.

The battlefield dynamic shifted dramatically after Melliandra's elimination. With her out of the picture, there was no longer a threat capable of disrupting the other teams as they worked on their challenges.

Meanwhile, the remaining combatants in the arena continued to apply relentless pressure on what was left of Team Destroyer. Their focus was to eliminate Team Destroyer as quickly as possible. Once that was done, they could turn their attention to battling one another to secure the coveted two spots for victory.
"I don't think even Team Destroyer can claw their way out of this one."
"Yeah, no matter how impressive they were in the first round, it looks like this is the end for them."
"Well, this is what happens when you underestimate your opponents and only bring five players to a match."
"If anyone's to blame, it's Broken for not showing up to this match."

"Who knows what that rising star is thinking? Maybe he's got a case of star syndrome? Lol." On the screen, the battle grew more intense as Venom, the werewolf-like Wrath Champion, relentlessly pressed Charmelyn. Despite her constant duplication to evade him, Venom's speed and raw power allowed him to keep up, swiftly destroying her clones one after another. His movements were feral and calculated, pushing Charmelyn closer to her limits.

Meanwhile, Kingsley was locked in a fierce duel with Mooz, who had taken his Armored Hawk form. It was like watching Kingsley fight his own beast-a high-speed aerial clash of claws, armor, and raw might. Mooz darted through the air with uncanny precision, putting Kingsley on the defensive.

Elsewhere, other players focused their efforts on cornering Goldrich, who struggled to hold the team together. He desperately tried to defend his teammates, unable to launch effective counter attacks against the coordinated assaults.

From another angle, Nexthar continued his long-range assault with the copied sniper rifle. Goldrich had to split his attention, constantly working to shield Starfall and Charmelyn, ensuring they weren't taken down in the escalating chaos.

Starfall unleashed attacks from his position, but it was evident the opposing players were hitting much harder. The pressure from every direction was overwhelming, leaving Team Destroyer completely cornered and fighting tooth and nail just to survive.

"I don't see how Team Destroyer can make it out of this situation, Paul. Honestly, I've got to give them respect for the effort they've put in. It's clear they've lasted much longer than anyone expected," Brando remarked.
"Yes, but it's pretty clear now-this is the end for Team Destroyer," Paul responded with a faint smirk. "It's quite ironic, isn't it? Team Destroyer... getting destroyed by their enemies."

The audience was captivated as Kingsley continued to endure the relentless barrage of attacks. Despite lacking a dedicated healing specialist on their team, Team Destroyer managed to hold out for an impressive amount of time. However, the repeated sniper shots aimed at Kingsley eventually broke through, and the tanker finally fell.

"Kingsley has been taken down! Now Team Destroyer has to survive without their cornerstone tanker. How will they manage? Or is this the end for them?" Brando exclaimed, his voice brimming with excitement.
"Well," Paul responded calmly, "it's been a performance worthy of praise. But it's clear their opponents came fully prepared to counter them effectively this time."

"Does that also mean Team Destroyer wasn't prepared for their enemies?" Brando asked. "They had to have known they wouldn't be able to survive against three Divine Champions who could actually challenge them, right?

"Well, even if they knew," Paul replied, "their defeat was inevitable from the start. They were outmatched strategically, outclassed in role players, and outnumbered. No matter how strong they are, when faced with opponents with double their numbers, they simply stood no chance."
"I think we can all agree with you on that, Paul," Brando said, nodding in agreement as the tension in the arena continued to build.
And just as everyone expected, another member of Team Destroyer fell-Goldrich was eliminated next!

The crowd gasped in surprise, watching as Goldrich, known for his incredible versatility, had managed to hold out and even take down several opponents before finally succumbing. Now, only two members of Team Destroyer remained.
"Charmelyn and Starfall are now being overwhelmed by multiple players attacking from all directions. I think it's only a matter of time before they, too, are taken down," Brando commented.
Paul chimed in, "Yes, and let's not forget, Brando, that three opposing teams have already completed their puzzles and are now engaged in fighting the Raid Boss."
The camera shifted to show the Raid Boss under siege, surrounded by nine players coordinating their attacks. Its massive form staggered under the relentless assault.
"With this, it won't be long before the Raid Boss is defeated, and the winners emerge," Paul continued.
"Yes, Paul, I can see that they're holding their ground well and delivering steady damage to the Raid Boss. I think the final outcome of this match is already crystal clear," Brando agreed.

The camera zoomed in on Charmelyn and Starfall, who now stood back-to-back, their bodies tense as they tried to position themselves amidst a circle of opponents closing in from all directions. Their silence spoke volumes-Charmelyn's lack of counterattacks and their labored stances made it obvious that their mana and stamina had been completely drained.

Not far from them stood Venom, the imposing werewolf. He smirked as he called out, "Well, girls, it's over. Why don't you just leave the game yourselves? Save yourselves the humiliation of being killed trying to defend something you can't possibly win."
Mooz, still in Kingsley's stolen Armored Hawk form, landed nearby. From another angle, Nexthar knelt, his sniper rifle trained on the two girls, ready to fire at any moment.

Venom took a step closer, his sharp teeth glinting in the light as he taunted them. "Charmelyn, Starfall... tell me, where's the leader of your team in a moment like this? Did you really think you could win with just five players? Now, you can see for yourselves what happens when you underestimate your opponents."

From outside the arena, the crowd erupted with mixed reactions. Some were jeering, others shouting boos in disapproval. It was clear that many of these voices came from Starfall's devoted fans, who had come to support her in this intense match.
"Damn it, this is so pathetic! I didn't come here to watch Starfall get treated like this!" one of the fans shouted angrily.

"Yes, and I loved Charmelyn's performance too! This is just awful for them," another added. "Just end it already! Damn it, they're ganging up on two girls who are already cornered!" The boos from the crowd grew louder, echoing across the arena. The sight of Charmelyn and Starfall, both struggling and seemingly being toyed with instead of outright defeated, only fueled the frustration of the audience.
"Why delay killing us?" Starfall said. "Isn't this what you wanted? The glory of defeating a single team by ganging up on them?
Venom smirked faintly. "All right, if that's what you want," he said, his tone cold as he began to approach Charmelyn.
In a final burst of desperation, Charmelyn lunged forward with her dagger, striking at Venom repeatedly. But each time, he effortlessly countered her attacks, overpowering her.
With a swift motion, he knocked the weapon from her hand and threw her to the ground. She struggled, but it was clear she couldn't get back up again.

Starfall dropped to her knees beside Charmelyn, her hands glowing faintly as she tried to heal her teammate. But the spell faltered, weak and ineffective-it was obvious Starfall herself had run out of stamina after the relentless battles they'd endured.
The once-mighty Team Destroyer was on the brink of complete collapse.
Brando and Paul watched the match progress with bated breath, the tension in the air thick as the match seemed to be near its conclusion.
But suddenly, the stadium erupted into deafening cheers, the energy shifting as the camera focused on an unexpected scene.
"Paul, what's going on?!" Brando exclaimed, leaning forward in surprise.
"Well," Paul said, "it looks like this battle isn't over just yet."

On the massive screen, the camera panned to someone stepping onto the stage. A young man with blonde hair and a tall, well-built physique came into view, shielding his eyes from the bright stadium lights. He broke into a sprint, heading straight for the row of capsule devices marked with Team Destroyer's logos.
"Paul, is that... Broken?! Yes, it's Broken!" Brando shouted, his voice almost drowned out by the thunderous roar of the crowd.
Cheers and applause echoed throughout the arena as fans erupted in excitement.
"This is incredible! Will Broken's arrival turn the tide of this match? Could this be the game- changer Team Destroyer desperately needs?" Brando said.
The young man climbed into one of the capsule devices, and moments later, the profile for
Broken lit up in green on the screen. The audience watched in stunned anticipation as the camera switched back to the game.

The virtual sky above the arena suddenly split apart with a blinding light, and from the heavens descended a massive, glowing spear, its arrival shaking the battlefield. "Broken has arrived!" Brando exclaimed, his voice electrified with excitement. The match, which seemed all but decided, had just taken an unpredictable and thrilling turn.

chapters.title: Chapter 761: The Bow of Envy
paragraphs: The camera focused on Broken, now soaring through the air atop his majestic flying fox. His spear was nocked onto his bow. It was a sight many had grown familiar with a moment that heralded chaos and destruction on a massive scale. Whenever Broken unleashed this signature move, devastation was inevitable, and every player on the ground knew it.

Above the arena, the virtual sky remained split open as the massive spear materialized, its radiant energy growing more intense with each passing second. The colossal weapon hovered ominously, ready to strike the earth below.

Players who realized the danger quickly scrambled into action. Panic set in as defensive buffs were cast in desperation, barriers shimmering into place to mitigate the impending damage. Others frantically sprinted away from the targeted area, hoping to escape the range of the devastating AoE attack.

Outside the arena, the audience was completely captivated, some cheering loudly while others watched in stunned silence. Anticipation filled the air as they braced themselves to witness just how much destruction Broken's signature skill would unleash.
"Paul, now tell me your opinion on this," Brando urged.

"Well," Paul began, "Broken has definitely arrived at the perfect time. However, he needs to be aware that his opponents won't just stand idly by while he charges up this attack. They're going to do everything in their power to interrupt him or minimize the damage."
From Broken's perspective, his presence in the match wasn't just a coincidence. He had intentionally logged into Immortal Legacy from his Northstar Homebus, parked near the venue.

While he had been traveling across the West Continent, he found himself locked in combat with a swarm of high-level monsters. It wasn't until he received a notification about his team being in trouble that he decided to act. Using a rare item from the Trial Tower to exit Battle Mode, he logged out of the game, racing to reach the stage just in time to join the fight.

Now back in the game, Broken surveyed the situation. He noticed the other teams closing in on defeating the Raid Boss, the monster visibly close to being taken down. But that didn't matter to him. No way was he letting his team lose just because he arrived late.
From below, Mooz, still in his Armored Hawk form, streaked through the air at high speed, heading straight for Broken. It was obvious Mooz intended to stop the charging attack at all costs.
But Broken's expression didn't waver. Instead, a faint smile crossed his lips as he murmured softly, "Gaia, I think it's time for you to show off."

A glowing figure suddenly appeared beside Broken, floating effortlessly in the air. The presence immediately grabbed everyone's attention. The spirit, with her humanoid form, radiated a regal and powerful aura, her appearance so striking that murmurs erupted throughout the audience.
"Damn! Is that a spirit with a human form?"
"I wonder how strong that spirit is?"
"From what I know, spirits with humanoid forms are at least Legendary-grade!"
"Are you serious? You mean Broken has a spirit of that level, and possibly more like it?" "This guy... This is exactly why Broken is who he is!

Gaia shot downward in a flash. Almost instantly, the grass across the arena floor began to writhe and grow uncontrollably, transforming into wild vines that lashed out at the players below. The vines coiled tightly around several players, binding them in place as they struggled to break free.

Even Mooz, in his Armored Hawk form, was caught in the spirit's control. Thick vines shot through the air, wrapping around his wings and claws, halting his advance. The once- dominant beast form now thrashed and flailed, unable to close the distance to Broken. The audience watched in awe, stunned by the sheer power of Gaia's crowd control abilities. "Is the spirit's control really this strong?!"
"How is this even fair? That's Legendary-grade, no doubt about it!"
High above, Broken smirked as he watched the chaos unfold.
"How bold of you to use Kingsley's skill against me," he said.

The charging sequence of Broken's spear attack was nearly complete. Mooz's movements grew more sluggish, his hawk form pinned in midair as if he had been singled out to become the primary target of the massive spear.
[bloodthorn]: "The way Mooz is struggling in those vines... he looks like a chicken wrapped in banana leaves before getting steamed!"
[Rurounitt]: "Venom watching this from the ground like: 'Maybe I'll just sit this one out, you know, reevaluate my life choices."
[JungleDan]: "This whole scene is Broken saying: Why be humble when you can be right?" [bukli_ajrullai]: "Can we just give the spirit her own player slot? She's doing all the work out here."
[Tony_Faunce]: "Everyone: 'Broken is OP.' Broken: This? Oh, I'm just warming up."
[Logan_Schmittka]: "At this rate, Broken doesn't even need to throw the spear. Mooz is already halfway to rage-quitting."
Maylon and Euna, seated comfortably in the audience, couldn't help but discuss the intense scene unfolding in the arena.
"Can't Mooz just steal Broken's skill instead of trying to stop him?" Euna asked.

Maylon paused for a moment, considering her question before answering. "I think his ability is limited to stealing skills from players or maybe has specific requirements. And the skill Broken is casting now-it's from his bow, isn't it?"
"Yes," Euna replied. "That Legendary-grade bow allows Broken to use any weapon as an arrow, and it automatically casts the weapon's skills along with it.
Maylon nodded. "And it's also possible that Mooz's ability has a cooldown or other limitations. Whatever the case, it's clear Broken won't be stopped now, and Mooz's fate is already sealed."

Euna chuckled softly, a sly smile forming on her face. "This guy... He really loves making these dramatic last-minute entrances, doesn't he? I wonder if he has a manager somewhere telling him exactly when to show up and when to disappear."
She turned her gaze toward Maylon with a teasing look.
"What?" Maylon asked, narrowing his eyes at her.
"I think you're a lot like him. Always showing up at the last minute when things get desperate," Euna said.
"Hah!" Maylon replied and leaned back in his chair. "I think it's just normal for cool people like us to make an entrance when it matters the most."

Just as Broken was about to release his charged arrow, the camera abruptly shifted to Nexthar -the player who had previously copied Melliandra's sniper rifle. Now, to everyone's shock, he was holding a bow identical to the one Broken was using.
The crowd gasped audibly, their disbelief echoing through the stadium.

"Paul! Your prediction just came true!" Brando shouted. "Nexthar has copied Broken's bow! How overpowered is this guy's ability when he can do something like this from such a distance, and make it look so easy?"
Paul smirked faintly. "It seems Nexthar's Envy Blessing is even more versatile than most of us imagined."

On the screen, Nexthar began charging an attack using the Golden Bow of Artemis he had copied. But that wasn't all-he was using Melliandra's sniper rifle as the arrow. The crowd erupted in shock and confusion.
"Wait! Is Nexthar really using two copied weapons at the same time?"

As the energy from the bow began to intensify, a swirling portal suddenly appeared behind Nexthar. From the portal, an ethereal figure emerged, wielding an even bigger version of Melliandra's sniper rifle. The spectral being aimed directly at Broken, who was still in midair preparing his attack.
The tension in the arena skyrocketed as the crowd watched the two devastatingly powerful attacks charge simultaneously, the battlefield bracing for a clash of titanic proportions.

sentences.text: The camera focused on Broken, now soaring through the air atop his majestic flying fox.
His spear was nocked onto his bow.
It was a sight many had grown familiar with a moment that heralded chaos and destruction on a massive scale.
Whenever Broken unleashed this signature move, devastation was inevitable, and every player on the ground knew it.
Above the arena, the virtual sky remained split open as the massive spear materialized, its radiant energy growing more intense with each passing second.
The colossal weapon hovered ominously, ready to strike the earth below.
Players who realized the danger quickly scrambled into action.
Panic set in as defensive buffs were cast in desperation, barriers shimmering into place to mitigate the impending damage.
Others frantically sprinted away from the targeted area, hoping to escape the range of the devastating AoE attack.
Outside the arena, the audience was completely captivated, some cheering loudly while others watched in stunned silence.
Anticipation filled the air as they braced themselves to witness just how much destruction Broken's signature skill would unleash.
"Paul, now tell me your opinion on this," Brando urged.
"Well," Paul began, "Broken has definitely arrived at the perfect time.
However, he needs to be aware that his opponents won't just stand idly by while he charges up this attack.
They're going to do everything in their power to interrupt him or minimize the damage."
From Broken's perspective, his presence in the match wasn't just a coincidence.
He had intentionally logged into Immortal Legacy from his Northstar Homebus, parked near the venue.

It wasn't until he received a notification about his team being in trouble that he decided to act.
Using a rare item from the Trial Tower to exit Battle Mode, he logged out of the game, racing to reach the stage just in time to join the fight.
Now back in the game, Broken surveyed the situation.
He noticed the other teams closing in on defeating the Raid Boss, the monster visibly close to being taken down.
But that didn't matter to him.
No way was he letting his team lose just because he arrived late.
From below, Mooz, still in his Armored Hawk form, streaked through the air at high speed, heading straight for Broken.
It was obvious Mooz intended to stop the charging attack at all costs.

Instead, a faint smile crossed his lips as he murmured softly, "Gaia, I think it's time for you to show off."
A glowing figure suddenly appeared beside Broken, floating effortlessly in the air.

Is that a spirit with a human form?"

This is exactly why Broken is who he is!
Gaia shot downward in a flash.
Almost instantly, the grass across the arena floor began to writhe and grow uncontrollably, transforming into wild vines that lashed out at the players below.
The vines coiled tightly around several players, binding them in place as they struggled to break free.
Even Mooz, in his Armored Hawk form, was caught in the spirit's control.
Thick vines shot through the air, wrapping around his wings and claws, halting his advance.
The once- dominant beast form now thrashed and flailed, unable to close the distance to Broken.
The audience watched in awe, stunned by the sheer power of Gaia's crowd control abilities.
"Is the spirit's control really this strong?!"
"How is this even fair?
That's Legendary-grade, no doubt about it!"
High above, Broken smirked as he watched the chaos unfold.
"How bold of you to use Kingsley's skill against me," he said.
The charging sequence of Broken's spear attack was nearly complete.
Mooz's movements grew more sluggish, his hawk form pinned in midair as if he had been singled out to become the primary target of the massive spear.

chapters.title: Chapter 762: Clash of the Golden Bows
paragraphs: Broken completed his charging attack, releasing the Mythic-grade Abyssal Wavebreaker Spear from his bow. The recoil alone created a shockwave so powerful that even Polly, staggered from its force.

Simultaneously, an enormous wave of water manifested from the sky, crashing downward in a spectacular display, accompanied by the form of a massive water boar that dove toward the ground with unstoppable momentum.

The stadium fell silent for a brief moment as the crowd stared, completely mesmerized. Many of them had never seen such a majestic skill effect before. The dazzling visuals on the massive screen and the thunderous sound system made it feel as though the ocean itself had descended into the arena.

The spear tore through the air with incredible speed, heading straight for Mooz. The moment it pierced through his body, the massive display showed the moment in slow motion. Mooz's profile immediately turned red, signifying his elimination from the match.

The spear slammed into the ground with devastating impact, unleashing a torrent of water that swept across the battlefield like a raging ocean. The sheer force of the attack sent every player nearby sprawling across the arena, unable to resist the immense pressure.
Even Nexthar, who had been in the middle of charging his own attack, was thrown violently backward by the aftershock of the skill, his aim shattered.

One by one, more players fell victim to the overwhelming power of Broken's skill. The profiles of two, then three, players turned red in rapid succession, indicating their eliminations. The arena erupted into a thunderous cheer as the crowd reacted to the breathtaking spectacle that had unfolded before their eyes.

"That's magnificent! Broken has truly shown just how devastating his skill can be," Brando shouted over the roaring audience. "It's no wonder he earned his reputation for large-scale destruction in the game, and now he's demonstrating that same prowess in this match, right in front of his opponents!"
But it didn't end there. Broken immediately began charging another attack, this time using his pickaxe. A massive, ethereal pickaxe materialized above him, spinning violently at incredible speed.

Meanwhile, on the ground, Nexthar, who had regained his footing, initiated another charging attack as well. He wielded the same copied Golden Bow of Artemis alongside Melliandra's sniper rifle. The crowd held their breath as the tension in the arena escalated.

The other players were still struggling to recover from Broken's earlier devastating attack, scrambling to their feet, when the ground began to quake violently once more. Broken released the spinning pickaxe from the bowstring, sending it hurtling through the air with immense force. Simultaneously, massive boulders began raining down from above, creating chaos on the battlefield.

At the same time, Nexthar unleashed his own attack. The sniper rifle shot into the sky, the ethereal form behind him firing a rapid series of shots alongside it, all aimed at Broken with deadly precision.

The stadium roared with the sound of the collisions and the explosions. On the giant screen, the moment of impact between Nexthar's sniper rifle and Broken's spinning pickaxe was highlighted in dramatic slow motion.
The sniper rifle shattered upon contact with the pickaxe, unable to withstand the sheer force of its rotation.

The pickaxe continued its unstoppable trajectory, hurtling straight toward Nexthar. The Envy Champion barely had time to react before the pickaxe struck him with devastating power. His body disintegrated on impact, his profile on the screen turning red, marking his elimination from the match.
Once again, the audience erupted into wild cheers, the stadium vibrating with excitement as Broken delivered yet another spectacular display of skill and power.

[Jim123]: "Team Destroyer went from 'about to lose' to 'hold up, let's give the audience a fireworks show.

On the giant screen, Broken was shown descending gracefully to the ground, landing right in front of Charmelyn and Starfall. The wild vines that covered the battlefield stretched out, collecting the spear and pickaxe, bringing them toward him. He stored the pickaxe in his inventory and grasped the spear firmly in his hand.
Turning to face the two girls, Broken tilted his head slightly and gave them a faint smile, almost chuckling.
"Charmelyn, Starfall... are you two okay?" he asked.
Charmelyn nodded slowly, her voice soft. "Thanks... Broken."
"You've got a serious hero complex, don't you? Showing up right when we were about to lose all hope," Starfall said with a weak chuckle as she stepped closer to him.
"Sorry for looking so useless," she added, brushing off some dirt from her robe. "We thought we could handle this just fine without you."
"We're a team. We're supposed to work together," Broken responded simply.

Starfall reached out and lightly grabbed his left arm, gently turning him to face the remaining enemies standing across the battlefield. Among them was Venom, the Wrath Champion, his imposing figure flanked by several other high-level combatants who had survived both of Broken's devastating AoE attacks. These players, all above level 200, were clearly not ordinary opponents.
Venom stood at the forefront, his wolfish grin showing no fear, his claws twitching with anticipation.
"I'll handle him," Broken said, his eyes locked on Venom. "You two take care of the rest."
Charmelyn stepped forward to Broken's right. "The Raid Boss is almost defeated," she said quietly.
"We still have a chance-if we take them down quickly," Broken replied.
Charmelyn nodded. "Thanks to Starfall, I've recovered."

With that, Charmelyn vanished, her form disappearing into the shadows as she moved toward the right flank. Starfall took a step back, her hands glowing as she began casting several magic circles that formed behind her, ready to provide support for both Broken and Charmelyn. The tension in the arena spiked once more as the final showdown began to take shape.
"That was surely an extraordinary performance, Broken," Venom said with a sly grin. "Or should I say... King Broken?"
"Thanks for the compliment," Broken replied casually. "And greetings to you as well. I'm honored to face a Divine Champion in person."
"You've got quite the mouth on you," Venom growled. "I know what you are. You're a Divine Champion too, aren't you? And what is it? Sloth Champion?"
Broken gave a faint smirk. "I don't think I'm worthy of answering that. I'm only here to ensure my team's victory.
Venom let out a low laugh. "No, you won't. Not if you can't beat me. My team is seconds away from finishing off the Raid Boss-we're about to win."
"No," Broken said, his voice steady but with an edge. "Not if I can take you down quickly."

With that, he placed the Abyssal Crown on his head, its energy crackling around him. The crown instantly boosted his overall damage, synergizing perfectly with his Mythic-grade spear. Broken spun the spear with fluid precision, stepping into an attack stance that sent ripples of anticipation through the stadium.

The crowd erupted into a frenzy, their cheers and shouts filling the air as the intensity reached its peak. Every fan in the stands was on the edge of their seat, their voices blending into one massive roar.

Brando, still watching the match intently, chimed in with his commentary. "Venom has a point. Even if Broken manages to defeat him, Team Destroyer still has the puzzles to solve and another wave of monsters to face. Do they even have enough time to pull this off?"

He turned to Paul, who smiled faintly before responding. "We don't know what kind of tricks Broken has up his sleeve, but you're right-time is incredibly tight, and every second counts in this match."

"And yet," Brando added, shaking his head in disbelief, "they have the nerve to have a little chat during such a critical moment. I just hope Broken has something planned to secure his team's victory!"

chapters.title: Chapter 763: Wrath Falls to the Abyss
paragraphs: Broken had no idea just how powerful the opponent standing before him truly was. A werewolf Beastkin. It was an interesting coincidence-especially since he was currently traveling through the West Continent, a region dominated by Beastkin clans.
Could Venom be from there as well?

According to information from Maylock, Venom was a Wrath Champion, likely possessing a blessing similar to Booba's-one that granted continuous stat boosts in battle. If that were true, fighting him would become significantly harder the longer the battle dragged on. If Venom's strength exceeded the standard power level of most players, this would be anything but an easy fight.

Spinning his spear, Broken didn't waste time with unnecessary words. He burst forward, closing the distance between them in an instant. He needed to strike repeatedly, testing the waters to gauge just how strong this opponent really was.
"Let's see the strength of the first player in Immortal Legacy to earn the title of King!" Venom sneered.
Broken's movements were fast, his attacks fluid. He struck-thrusting his spear forward in rapid succession. A precise strike. A piercing thrust. Then-
What?!
Venom dodged. Effortlessly.
His speed was insane-faster than Broken had expected. Before Broken could react, the werewolf deflected the spear with his claws and instantly sidestepped, repositioning himself with inhuman agility.
Then came the counterattack.

Venom lashed out in a blur, delivering a series of rapid, brutal strikes. Broken barely had time to raise his spear, blocking the incoming attacks in succession. But even with his reflexes, several of Venom's attacks slipped through, landing clean hits against him.
Damn! Broken cursed internally, adjusting his stance as he held his ground.
This guy was ridiculously fast!

Broken didn't waste a second. He knew that cooldowns in the arena weren't shared with those in the main game. That meant he could use every ability in his arsenal-including those with long cooldowns-without worrying about conserving them. Since he only had one or two matches to play per day, he could afford to go all out.
Without hesitation, he activated his Water Domain.

A vast surge of water erupted around them, instantly changing the battlefield. The shimmering liquid warped the space within it, slowing everything inside except for Broken himself. Now, he had the upper hand-or so he thought.
Even with the domain's slow movement debuff, Venom was still fast.
Too fast.

Despite the resistance from the water, Venom pushed through, his attacks still slipping through with ridiculous precision. He moved with an unnatural level of speed and agility, continuing to land clean hits against Broken's defenses.

Luckily, Broken had a tank-heavy build-his stats were loaded with defensive perks, making him incredibly difficult to take down. Venom's strikes were landing, but they weren't enough to put him in real danger.
More importantly, Broken wasn't even fighting seriously yet.
This was just the beginning. He had yet to show everything he was capable of.
"Gaia, release everything!" Broken commanded.
At his words, the battlefield erupted with a surge of life. From the ground, Gaia Beasts materialized one after another.
Each of them locked onto Venom, launching relentless attacks from all directions. Ranged strikes blasted through the air, forcing the werewolf Champion into a defensive stance.
At the same time, the vines tightened their grip, continuously attempting to crowd-control Venom, restricting his movements bit by bit.
Even with his insane speed, this was becoming a problem.

For the first time, Venom was struggling to maneuver freely. He was still fast-but with attacks flying at him from every direction and vines constantly pulling at his limbs, the fight had suddenly turned into a painful endurance battle.
This guy is an absolute pain to fight... Broken grumbled internally, watching as Venom desperately tried to break free. That speed of his is really starting to piss me off.

Venom tried to retreat, dodging and weaving to escape the relentless onslaught, but Broken had no time to play games. He knew he had less than a minute to finish this fight.
With a quiet sigh, he activated the one skill guaranteed to put this dog down-fast.

The ethereal warrior loomed over him, clad in black armor with glowing golden veins running through it. In its hands, it wielded a massive greatsword, pulsing with overwhelming power, floating like a guardian of judgment-ready to punish its target.
Besides, Broken had already showcased this ability in the previous war. There was no reason for him to hide it anymore.

Not that it mattered. No one needed to know how he had obtained the Golden Paragon in the first place.
But wait...
Why did this feel too easy?

Too late.
Broken was already in front of him.

"I thought you wanted a fair fight?" he said smoothly.

Broken's spear tore through the air.
And then-destruction.

Eliminated.
The stadium exploded into cheers and screams of shock.

Without hesitation, he activated three skills simultaneously from his Mythic-grade
Wavebreaker Spear.
[Abyssal Cascade - Torrent of Destruction (Active Skill) activated]

[X Abyssal Spear - Piercing Spear of the Abyss (Active Skill) activated]

A titanic wave of water descended from the empty air, crashing down onto the battlefield like a natural disaster. A colossal Abyssal Tideboar-its body formed from swirling ocean currents -barreled through the chaos, obliterating everything in its path.
The sheer scale of destruction left everyone speechless.

Broken and his team catch up to the other parties who are this close to defeating the Raid Boss? Solving the puzzles won't be as easy as wiping out players with a single skill!"

A werewolf Beastkin.
It was an interesting coincidence-especially since he was currently traveling through the West Continent, a region dominated by Beastkin clans.
Could Venom be from there as well?
According to information from Maylock, Venom was a Wrath Champion, likely possessing a blessing similar to Booba's-one that granted continuous stat boosts in battle.
If that were true, fighting him would become significantly harder the longer the battle dragged on.
If Venom's strength exceeded the standard power level of most players, this would be anything but an easy fight.
Spinning his spear, Broken didn't waste time with unnecessary words.
He burst forward, closing the distance between them in an instant.
He needed to strike repeatedly, testing the waters to gauge just how strong this opponent really was.
"Let's see the strength of the first player in Immortal Legacy to earn the title of King!" Venom sneered.
Broken's movements were fast, his attacks fluid.
He struck-thrusting his spear forward in rapid succession.
A precise strike.
A piercing thrust.
Then-
What?!
Venom dodged.
Effortlessly.
His speed was insane-faster than Broken had expected.
Before Broken could react, the werewolf deflected the spear with his claws and instantly sidestepped, repositioning himself with inhuman agility.
Then came the counterattack.
Venom lashed out in a blur, delivering a series of rapid, brutal strikes.
Broken barely had time to raise his spear, blocking the incoming attacks in succession.
But even with his reflexes, several of Venom's attacks slipped through, landing clean hits against him.
Damn!
Broken cursed internally, adjusting his stance as he held his ground.
This guy was ridiculously fast!
Broken didn't waste a second.
He knew that cooldowns in the arena weren't shared with those in the main game.
That meant he could use every ability in his arsenal-including those with long cooldowns-without worrying about conserving them.
Since he only had one or two matches to play per day, he could afford to go all out.
Without hesitation, he activated his Water Domain.
A vast surge of water erupted around them, instantly changing the battlefield.
The shimmering liquid warped the space within it, slowing everything inside except for Broken himself.
Now, he had the upper hand-or so he thought.
Even with the domain's slow movement debuff, Venom was still fast.
Too fast.
Despite the resistance from the water, Venom pushed through, his attacks still slipping through with ridiculous precision.
He moved with an unnatural level of speed and agility, continuing to land clean hits against Broken's defenses.
Luckily, Broken had a tank-heavy build-his stats were loaded with defensive perks, making him incredibly difficult to take down.
Venom's strikes were landing, but they weren't enough to put him in real danger.
More importantly, Broken wasn't even fighting seriously yet.
This was just the beginning.
He had yet to show everything he was capable of.
"Gaia, release everything!" Broken commanded.
At his words, the battlefield erupted with a surge of life.
From the ground, Gaia Beasts materialized one after another.
Each of them locked onto Venom, launching relentless attacks from all directions.
Ranged strikes blasted through the air, forcing the werewolf Champion into a defensive stance.
At the same time, the vines tightened their grip, continuously attempting to crowd-control Venom, restricting his movements bit by bit.
Even with his insane speed, this was becoming a problem.
For the first time, Venom was struggling to maneuver freely.
He was still fast-but with attacks flying at him from every direction and vines constantly pulling at his limbs, the fight had suddenly turned into a painful endurance battle.
This guy is an absolute pain to fight...
Broken grumbled internally, watching as Venom desperately tried to break free.
That speed of his is really starting to piss me off.

chapters.title: Chapter 764: The 7-Second Miracle
paragraphs: Broken, Charmelyn, and Starfall rushed toward the gate, the first obstacles standing between them and the Raid Boss.
But before they could even think about joining the fight, they had to solve the puzzle.
The challenge wasn't just about unlocking the gate-it required careful analysis, time to figure out the mechanics before they could even begin solving it. And time was the one thing they didn't have.

On the giant screen, their faces were displayed side by side with another feed-the rival teams hammering away at the Raid Boss. Even though the opposing players were visibly struggling, the boss was already in its second phase, and it was clear... victory was near.
Brando, ever the sharp-eyed caster, jumped back into the analysis.

"How about we check the fastest record for solving this puzzle?" he suggested, his tone serious. "The current record stands at 2 minutes and 30 seconds. And that was set by a world champion puzzle solver someone who dominates even outside Immortal Legacy."
Brando's expression darkened slightly as he looked at the Raid Boss's health bar. "Meanwhile, based on how this battle is going, the Raid Boss will fall in less than a minute."
He turned toward Paul, who simply crossed his legs, watching the match unfold with a knowing expression.
"Well," Paul finally said, exhaling slowly, "at the very least, Team Destroyer put on one hell of a show. But this is where their journey ends, I think."
Suddenly, a notification sound echoed across the arena, drawing everyone's attention to the screen-something no one had expected had just happened.
"What happened?! What did Broken just do?!" Brando shouted, his voice filled with shock.
On the screen, Broken stood in front of the now-open gate, a simple pickaxe in his hand. Next to him, a new record time was displayed-he had solved the puzzle in just 7 seconds.
7 SECONDS.
The stadium erupted with disbelief.
"How in the world did Broken do that?!"
"Wait-did he use some kind of weird trick?!"
A replay was immediately played on the giant screen, showing exactly what Broken had done.
The footage revealed that Broken had simply hit the gate twice with the pickaxe. Two swings. And just like that-the puzzle was solved. The gate had opened.
Paul, who had been calmly watching the match, straightened in his seat, his usual composed expression shifting into one of intense focus. His eyes narrowed as he processed what he had just witnessed.
"Paul, tell me what just happened?!" Brando demanded. "Is Broken's pickaxe so powerful that it can somehow solve puzzles?!"
Paul studied the footage closely. The pickaxe Broken had used... looked completely normal. It wasn't a legendary item. It wasn't a high-grade tool. It was just a simple, low-tier pickaxe.
There was no way a tool like that could bypass a complex puzzle designed to test intelligence and problem-solving skills.

"...No," Paul finally said, his tone measured. "I don't think it's the pickaxe. I think he has another secret. Something else. A special class? A hidden ability? Or maybe... something tied to his Divine Champion blessing?"
Brando turned to him sharply. "And now, Paul-tell me. Just what kind of blessing does Broken actually have?"
The screen continued to display Broken, Charmelyn, and Starfall, now facing yet another wave of monsters. But this time, they didn't even need the Gaia Beasts to intervene.
With precise coordination, the three unleashed powerful AoE attacks, wiping out the monsters effortlessly before Broken even had to call for backup.
Then, another gate appeared.
This was the final puzzle standing between them and the Raid Boss.
The audience leaned forward in anticipation-was what Broken did earlier just a coincidence?
Or could he really solve these puzzles just by using his pickaxe?
With his usual composure, Broken did the same thing as before.
He struck the gate once.
...Nothing happened.
The crowd stared.
He hit it again.
...Still nothing.
"Wait... why isn't it opening? He only had to hit it twice before, right?!"
"I knew it! That was just dumb luck. There's no way a puzzle like this can be solved by hitting it with a pickaxe!"
"Yeah, I refuse to believe it. That was completely cheating!"
Broken struck the gate again.
Nothing.
"Told you, Broken was just messing around."
"Well, it's over for them. The Raid Boss is going down in a matter of seconds."
But then-on the fourth hit.
The gate swung open.
"WHAT THE HELL?!"
"IT ACTUALLY OPENED?!"
"BROKEN REALLY DID IT AGAIN?!"
The stadium erupted into chaos.
"What kind of pickaxe is that?! This has to be unfair!"
"I don't see anything unfair about it. There's no rule saying the puzzle has to be solved normally."
"He completely brute-forced his way through! These puzzles are designed to test intelligence and teamwork... but he just ignored all of that!"
It wasn't just the players in the match who were stunned anymore-even the casters were speechless.

Broken stepped into the open battlefield, his eyes locking onto the towering creature ahead- a massive elephant-like beast with long, curved tusks, standing at three times the height of an average human. The Raid Boss.
All around it, players swarmed, attacking from every direction, desperate to bring it down.
Then, they noticed him.
Their gazes snapped toward Broken, Charmelyn, and Starfall as they entered the fray.
"Someone stop them! Don't let them get close!"
"There's no way he's winning this. They're only three people. They can't steal the last hit!
"Yeah, we've already done most of the damage. There's nothing they can do!" Even as they argued among themselves, Broken, Charmelyn, and Starfall simply kept walking.
They closed the distance with measured steps, completely ignoring the shouting players. "STOP RIGHT THERE! You're too late! This monster belongs to us!" one of them yelled.
Broken didn't slow down.
"Weren't you the ones saying it's pointless for us to try-since the last hit will go to you anyway?" he said.
"CUT THE CRAP, BROKEN! I KNOW YOU'RE GONNA PULL SOME DIRTY TRICK!" another player snapped.
The attacks didn't stop. The other teams continued their assault on the Raid Boss, determined to end it before Broken could do anything.
But then-a shift in the battlefield.
The gate behind them burst open.

From it, twelve Gaia Beasts rushed forward, their massive forms crashing into the battlefield. They attacked from all directions, disrupting the players who were too focused on the Raid Boss, forcing them to split their attention.
The battlefield descended into chaos.
And it didn't stop there.
A shadow loomed over the battlefield.
Emerging from behind Broken was a colossal figure-twice the height of him.
Its black, stone-like body radiated raw, primal power, wrapped in writhing shadow vines that pulsed with dark energy.
It was Blackthorn Golem.
The momentum shifted instantly.
Broken, Charmelyn, and Starfall joined the fight.
The Raid Boss's health plummeted the final moments of the battle drawing near.
And then-the screen flashed.
The other players stood frozen, their eyes locked on the Raid Boss as its massive body broke apart into tiny glowing pixels, vanishing from the battlefield.
For a split second, no one moved. No one spoke.
Then-
"Wait... who got the last hit?!"
A wave of panic and urgency swept across the arena as every player scrambled to check their system notifications, desperate to see the final result.
The audience held their breath, the tension in the stadium so thick it felt like time had stopped.
And then-
A notification appeared on the giant display, announcing the team who had secured the last hit.

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Did Broken Cheat?
paragraphs: [TEAM DESTROYER HAS SECURED THE LAST HIT ON THE RAID BOSS!]
The massive announcement flashed across the giant screen, confirming what many had refused to believe possible.
Team Destroyer had won.
For a moment, the stadium was silent.
Instead of immediate cheers, shock rippled through the crowd-players and spectators alike left stunned, their mouths slightly open as they processed what had just happened.
Then-
Brando's voice exploded through the speakers.
"UNBELIEVABLE! TEAM DESTROYER SECURES THE LAST HIT! AGAINST ALL ODDS- BROKEN AND HIS TEAM STEAL VICTORY RIGHT AT THE END!"
The silence shattered.
The entire stadium ERUPTED into cheers.
A few furious players stomped their feet, their frustration boiling over at how victory had slipped through their fingers at the very last second.
Inside the game, the aftermath of the battle unfolded. Several frustrated players, having failed to claim victory, rage quit, immediately logging out in frustration.
Meanwhile, near the center of the battlefield, Starfall spun around in excitement. She barely hesitated before throwing herself at Broken, wrapping her arms around him.
"Broken, we won! We won!" she screamed with pure joy.

Broken, still catching his breath from the intense fight, let out a rare smile. Victory was theirs. The big screen in the arena broadcasted their celebration, displaying the three remaining members of Team Destroyer. Charmelyn stood slightly apart from them, her expression unreadable beneath the mask that covered the lower half of her face.
Noticing this, Starfall immediately turned and pulled Charmelyn into a tight hug, sharing their moment of triumph together.
A few moments later, the three emerged from their capsule devices in the real world. As they stepped onto the stage, Goldrich, Kingsley, and Melliandra approached, joining them in celebration.
The arena buzzed with energy as media crews and camera operators quickly swarmed in, eager to interview the victors.
Team Destroyer had done it.

The questions came rapid-fire, most of them aimed directly at Starfall. It was no surprise- after all, she wasn't just a top-tier player, but also a globally recognized celebrity, actress, and singer. Her presence alone had drawn countless fans to the event, many of whom were now cheering from the stands.
"Starfall-or should I say, Heejin? This grand event has gathered viewers from all over the world, and I've noticed that a huge number of them are your fans. What would you like to say to them?"

Starfall smiled humbly and responded, "Thanks for the support, everyone! Playing here was an amazing experience, and knowing that my fans were cheering for me made it even more special. I appreciate you all!"
But then came the question that made the crowd buzz with curiosity-
"Starfall, what's your relationship with Broken? You two seem really close. Is there something special between you?"
Starfall turned slightly, directing her attention to another question. "Broken is a leader and a player I deeply respect and admire."
"People want to know more details.
"Is there a romantic connection between you two? You've posted pictures together before, haven't you?"
The media kept pressing, but before she could respond, another wave of questions was suddenly redirected toward Broken.
"Broken, many people are wondering why didn't you show up from the beginning? Was there a specific reason? Did you underestimate your opponents?"
"Broken, what's the secret behind the tool you used to solve the puzzles so easily? Was it some kind of exploit or cheat?"
The cameras zoomed in as Broken finally answered, his voice calm yet firm.
"We never underestimated any of our opponents. I wasn't here from the start because I was dealing with something important-something that couldn't wait."
"As for the tool? It was just an ordinary pickaxe. Nothing special about it."
But then, another question shifted the focus entirely.

"Broken, you're the only player in Immortal Legacy who has managed to marry one of the most powerful and influential figures in Yunatea. But people are curious-do you have any romantic connections with other players outside the game?"
Broken's expression remained neutral, his response composed yet straightforward.
"I feel like my time is already occupied with the game, my studies, and my family. And also... my friends."
His words left just enough mystery to fuel further speculation, while at the same time, making it clear that he wasn't interested in entertaining unnecessary gossip.

"The hero never fails to amaze everyone." Booyoung smirked.
Ronald, standing nearby with his arms crossed, chimed in. "Well, as the manager, I have to say-I'm proud of how this team turned out."
Booyoung turned toward him, raising an eyebrow. "And I hate you for not including me in it."

"Shut up, I'm a Wrath Champion!" Booyoung retorted.
"By bribing your way in," Euna quipped, smirking.
Laughter erupted around the room.

Booyoung turned to Leon with a teasing grin. "You're free, right?"
Leon chuckled, nodding slightly. "Like I'd ever miss a chance to hang out with you guys."
Booyoung smacked him on the back-this time harder-grinning. "Shut up, playboy. Who taught you to sound this smooth? You do realize that after tonight, Heejin's fans are going to hunt you down, right?

The moment she realized the attention was on her, Heejin's eyes widened in shock as she frantically shook her head. "No, they won't! My fans are so kind!"
Euna, arms crossed, raised an eyebrow. "Yeah... I'm not so sure about that."
The entire room burst into laughter.

One particularly heated interview came from Mooz, who still seemed bitter about the outcome.

"I firmly believe the tournament officials need to review the results of this match," Mooz stated. "Broken didn't follow the rules properly. He used a tool to force their way through to victory. That's completely unfair."
In another interview, Venom, who had faced Broken directly, voiced his own frustrations.

"Broken had way too many summons. He basically brought extra personnel into the game. Summons shouldn't be allowed in a competition like this-it just turns everything into a numbers game. I think the rules need to be clarified moving forward."
Other players also chimed in, some of them sounding outright furious.

"We refuse to participate in the final round if Broken's exploits are allowed to continue. The puzzles were meant to be solved, not bypassed! That completely defeats the purpose of this match. It's about solving puzzles, not breaking them!"
The controversy surrounding Broken's unconventional gameplay was growing rapidly, and it was clear that the debate was far from over.

As the controversy surrounding Broken's victory spread, Heejin's fans also began voicing their frustration online. Social media was flooded with heated comments, sparking debates across multiple platforms.
"I love Heejin, but I don't trust Broken at all. He's just using her popularity to boost his own name!"
"BROKEN, KEEP YOUR DISTANCE FROM OUR QUEEN. She doesn't need you to shine-she's already a global star. Stop stealing the spotlight!"
"This guy is literally ruining Starfall's brand. Why does she even team up with him???"
"I bet he's just riding on Heejin's fame. He's not even that special-just another overhyped player."
"Heejin's fans should BOYCOTT any event where Broken is involved. We need to make our voices heard!"
"Starfall's interviews are always so classy, and then you have Broken acting like nothing happened. He doesn't deserve to be in the same spotlight as her!"
Ronald grumbled in frustration, scrolling through the endless complaints and accusations flooding the internet as they sat together for dinner with the guild members.
"These assholes!" he snapped, his grip tightening on his phone. "Do I need to step up my game and give them a reality check? Maybe a nice, hard slap to wake them up?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 766: The Spear Duelist
paragraphs: The controversy surrounding Team Destroyer's victory continued to escalate, with numerous protests emerging from various players and communities. Most of the complaints revolved around Broken's unconventional method of solving the puzzles, which many argued was a blatant exploit rather than legitimate problem-solving.

Additionally, players voiced frustration over Broken's high-grade summons, claiming that his Legendary-grade spirit and battle-ready beasts essentially functioned as extra team members. Some argued that Team Destroyer wasn't just six players-with the summons included, they were seven, maybe even more. After all, the Spirit Beasts alone could fight one-on-one against level 200 players, making them a serious advantage.
In response to the backlash, the officials held a press conference to address the concerns.
A well-dressed man in a sleek black suit, his dark hair neatly combed back, sat at the podium, dozens of microphones pointed in his direction.
Clearing his throat, he began speaking in a measured and professional tone:

"We have thoroughly reviewed everything that transpired during the match-including the skills used, the tools equipped, and the actions taken by every player involved. As always, we are committed to ensuring that this competition remains fair for all participants."
He paused briefly before addressing the first major concern.

"Regarding the protests about summons being used in the match-let me clarify. Summons, high-tier weapons, and powerful gear are all part of a player's earned strength. These assets were not acquired unfairly, but rather through the players' own efforts. Additionally, we have confirmed that all player profiles were fully synchronized before Eternal Challenge began. This ensures that every participant is competing with their current, legitimate progress. Thus, the use of summons does not violate any existing rules."
He then moved on to the puzzle-solving controversy.

"As for the method used to complete the puzzles-we have decided to implement certain rule adjustments. Moving forward, all puzzles must be solved in the intended manner, requiring team cooperation and analytical skills. This decision was made to preserve the original purpose of the challenge."
The press conference was brief and to the point. Though many attendees remained dissatisfied, the officials had spoken-and their decision was final.
Ronald slammed his hand on the table, his frustration evident as he scrolled through the official statement.
"These officials have no brains! How can they just change the rules midway like this? Where is their professionalism?!" he snapped.

"Hah!" Booyoung huffed, crossing his arms. "I'm pretty sure they already knew that Broken could solve puzzles in his own way. Either they ignored it, or they caved under the pressure from all those complaints."

Sitting across from them, Booyoung glanced at Freya, raising an eyebrow in silent question. Freya simply grinned, offering no direct opinion. "I can't really comment on that," she said lightly. "I'm just here as Broken's assistant, after all." She chuckled.
London, Goldrich leaned forward, his expression calm but confident. "We don't need to worry. If Leon joins the final match, puzzles won't be an issue. I can handle them on my own."
Booyoung, however, was still fuming. "The problem isn't the puzzles. It's these idiots trying to win by cornering Leon. That pisses me off.
Heejin, who had been quietly following the conversation, finally spoke up. "It looks like the next battle will be even more brutal. They all will go after us."
Booyoung smirked, leaning back. "Then just buy one of the enemy teams and make them turn against each other. That would be chaos."
Euna, Elincia scoffed, rolling her eyes. "Of course, the only thing on your mind is buying your way through everything, huh? No wonder your level is so low, Booyoung."
Booyoung grinned mischievously. "Relax. I'll be level 200 soon. Hehe."
Finally, Leon spoke up as the room turned their attention to him. "Yes, I'll be joining the final match. So there's no need to worry-we can still win."

He paused briefly before adding with a slight smirk. "Unfortunately, I won't be able to create golems and use them in the match, since all player profiles are already synchronized. But no worries. Even Pawpaw hasn't entered the game yet."
At that, Euna let out a chuckle, shaking her head. "I'm pretty sure Pawpaw alone is enough to give those players the slap they deserve."

After some time, the bracket tournament for the Duel of Champions was finally revealed. A total of 64 participants had been selected based on their performance and reputation in the game. Each competitor was a well-known name, someone with enough skill to earn their place in this high-level competition.
The bracket was split into four groups, each containing 16 players. The tournament would follow a single-elimination format, meaning every match was one-on-one, winner advances, loser is eliminated.
Among the Vensalor Guild representatives, several names appeared: Broken, of course. Booba, the Wrath Champion. Elincia, and Livelywood.
However, there was one unfortunate twist-Elincia and Livelywood had been placed in the same group. This meant that, no matter what happened, only one of them could make it to the semifinals.

Meanwhile, Booba found himself in the same bracket as Constantine, the other Wrath Champion. Instead of being upset, Booba was actually excited-this was a perfect chance to finally fight Constantine in an official match.

Another major competitor stood out-Frostedge. He had been placed in a different group from Broken, which meant that if both of them won every match in their respective paths, they would likely meet in the grand finals.
But one thing immediately caught Broken's attention.
Galactron's name was missing.
He frowned slightly. "Galactron isn't in the tournament?"
London chuckled. "Who can even predict what someone like Galactron is thinking?"
Maylon, who had been checking the participant list, added, "Most likely, he isn't competing at all."
"Oh really? Ah, so lame," Ronald scoffed. "I mean, I saw some of his guild members here. Like that domain guy... and the demon girl."
"SpeedGang and Akiko," Euna clarified.
Booyoung leaned back with a smirk. "Yeah, though we already know the secrets behind their blessings."
As they continued discussing the tournament, Heejin suddenly turned toward Leon, her expression serious but with a small smile.
"Leon... you have to win and face Frostedge in the finals."
Leon met her gaze, smiling slightly as he nodded. "That would be fun."
"Yeah," Heejin added, "a lot of people weren't satisfied with how your sparring match ended last time. This final battle needs to happen in a proper environment now."
A true clash between Broken and Frostedge-one of the most anticipated fights-was now a very real possibility.

Several videos and interviews featuring the tournament contestants began circulating online. One in particular caught Leon's and the others' attention as they sat at the dinner table-an interview with Leon's first opponent in the upcoming match.
Surprisingly, this opponent wasn't a Divine Champion but rather someone renowned for his talent with an Epic-grade class.
The screen showed a man with curly hair and a shorter stature, standing in front of a tall female interviewer. Despite the size difference, his confidence was undeniable.
"I have perfect control over my spear!" he declared boldly into the camera. "I am a better spear fighter than Broken!"
Then, as if directly challenging him, he stared into the camera with absolute determination.
"Broken, face me like a real warrior! Don't hide behind your summons! Let's show everyone who the true master of the spear is!"
